findings.claim: The packaged exe entry point defaults to port 4319 via PLAN_LEDGER_WEB_PORT and binds 127.0.0.1, opening the browser unless PLAN_LEDGER_NO_OPEN is set

findings.subject: scripts/build-exe.mjs#sea-config.json
findings.claim: The build references sea-config.json (line 32) but no such file exists in the repository, so step 2/5 would fail unless it is generated or supplied externally

findings.subject: scripts/build-exe.mjs#sea blob
findings.claim: The injected blob is read from build/sea-prep.blob, which is expected to be produced by 'node --experimental-sea-config' and is not otherwise generated by any repo script

findings.subject: src/db.mjs#tokenize
findings.claim: tokenize lowercases, splits on non-alphanumeric/underscore, keeps tokens longer than 2 chars, and drops a STOP set of common words

findings.subject: src/db.mjs#idfRank
findings.claim: idfRank scores each entry as the sum of IDF weights (log(1+N/df)) of query tokens present in the entry, keeps score>0, sorts descending, and slices to limit

findings.subject: src/db.mjs#getLessons
findings.claim: getLessons ranks non-pass attempts across plans using idfRank over step_title+what_tried+result, excluding the step's own attempts and (unless all=true) other projects

findings.subject: src/db.mjs#getLessons
findings.claim: when step_id is given, getLessons appends the step's title and tools to the query terms and scopes to that step's project

findings.subject: src/db.mjs#getLessons
findings.claim: getLessons tie-breaks equal scores by created_at descending (newer first)

findings.subject: src/db.mjs#recall
findings.claim: recall builds a single ranked index of plan, step, attempt, and active finding docs (each with a concatenated text field) and ranks them with the same idfRank

findings.subject: src/db.mjs#recall
findings.claim: recall only includes findings with status 'active', and surfaces findings with non-empty conflicts_with as status 'conflict'

findings.subject: src/db.mjs#currentProjectId
findings.claim: project scoping defaults to the settings key 'current_project' (or 1 if unset), and NULL project_id is treated as project 1 in both recall and getLessons

findings.subject: scripts/runner-lib.mjs#parseVerdict
findings.claim: The inject-mode result contract requires the agent's final line to match /^\s*VERDICT:\s*(pass|fail|partial)\s*(?:[—–-]+\s*(.*))?$/i; a missing marker resolves to verdict 'fail' with null what_tried

findings.subject: scripts/runner-lib.mjs#parseFindings
findings.claim: The FINDINGS line is optional and strictly additive — malformed JSON, non-array, or non-object items never fail the step; they return empty findings plus an error string the runner only logs

findings.subject: scripts/runner-lib.mjs#FINDINGS_MAX
findings.claim: At most 20 findings are kept per output (FINDINGS_MAX=20), and the parser scans lines from the bottom up, taking the last FINDINGS line found

findings.subject: scripts/runner-lib.mjs#parseVerify
findings.claim: VERIFY is an optional first-line convention in step.context parsed via /^VERIFY:\s*(.+)$/m, left verbatim in context and never stripped

findings.subject: scripts/runner-lib.mjs#runVerify
findings.claim: runVerify runs the VERIFY command with shell:true (deliberate, trusted step-author input) and a 10-minute default timeout, returning ok/code/tail where tail is the last 500 chars of combined stdout+stderr

findings.subject: scripts/runner-lib.mjs#applyVerifyGate
findings.claim: The VERIFY gate only downgrades a claimed 'pass' to 'fail' when the command exits non-zero; it is a no-op when there is no VERIFY command or the claimed verdict was not 'pass'

findings.subject: scripts/runner.mjs#workPlan
findings.claim: In inject mode the runner parses the verdict, applies the VERIFY gate, records the attempt with executor 'runner-inject', and absorbs findings only when the run did not error (res.isError false)

findings.subject: scripts/runner.mjs#workPlan
findings.claim: In MCP mode the VERIFY gate re-checks after the agent exits: if the step status is 'done' but VERIFY fails, the runner records an overriding fail attempt with executor 'runner-mcp'
